records.answer: TruePay helps business owners understand card processing costs from our home in Josephine, Texas. Serving business owners since 2011.
A statement review explains your processing fees and effective rate. TruePay compares your options and helps you decide whether switching makes sense.
Your effective rate is total processing fees divided by card sales, multiplied by 100. Use one month’s statement to see your starting point.
Reach TruePay about your equipment, deposits, billing or account. Call 888-792-0284 or email support@gotruepay.com.
Tell TruePay about pricing, equipment or switching processors. A person from our Josephine, Texas team can discuss what your business needs.
This page shows a confirmation after a contact request is delivered. If you haven’t submitted a request, start with a statement review or contact the team.
TruePay’s rate lock covers its markup and monthly fees. Card-network costs can still change.
Your cost depends on how your business takes payments. Compare the pricing model and the whole bill before choosing.
Membership separates card-network costs from TruePay’s markup. See how the program works and what comes with it.
Dual pricing shows a cash price and a card price before payment. See how checkout works and whether the approach fits your business.
Start with where and how your customers pay. Explore terminals, POS systems and software around the way your business works.
Choose a POS around how your team takes orders and payments. TruePay helps you compare systems for your counter, tables and everyday workflow.
Choose a countertop or handheld terminal around where your customers pay. Compare the connection, screen and receipt options that matter to your team.
Take payment where you meet your customer. Start with a portable terminal or app, then work through the connection and receipt you need.
Connect online payments to the way your website sells. TruePay starts with your platform, then helps you explore a suitable gateway.
You may be able to keep your current POS when changing processors. Share your system details so TruePay can check the connection first.
Keep your invoice and payment workflow connected. Explore Biller Genie or MantaPay around the way you use QuickBooks.
Jon Wilson founded TruePay and serves as CEO. Tim Files is an owner and investor, and Shane Spears oversees day-to-day operations.
TruePay’s team works across pricing, operations, equipment and merchant support. Start with the people below, then contact the team about what your business needs.
Jon Wilson founded TruePay in 2011 after watching business owners struggle with processing fees. His work focuses on merchant pricing, statements and dual pricing.
Shane oversees TruePay’s day-to-day operations. His work connects onboarding, equipment and merchant support.
